annotation.title_clean: Study to support an impact assessment of regulatory requirements for Artificial Intelligence in Europe
annotation.title_en: Study to support an impact assessment of regulatory requirements for Artificial Intelligence in Europe
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Renda, A.; Fanni, R.; Laurer, M.; Sipiczki, A.; Yeung, T.; Maridis, G. et al. (European Commission DG CONNECT; Wavestone; CEPS; ICF)
annotation.venue: Publications Office of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: Publications Office catalogue record for the final report of a study supporting the Commission's impact assessment of the proposed EU AI Regulation. It covers AI risks to fundamental rights and safety, national regulatory approaches, analysis of the White Paper consultation, and compliance cost estimates.
key_provisions_or_claims: Reviews evidence on AI risks to fundamental rights and safety/security
Compares national AI strategies and risk governance approaches
Analyses 6,667 free-text responses and 408 position papers from the White Paper consultation
Estimates administrative and substantive compliance costs of the proposed AI Regulation
